tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga rgya mtsho dga' ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga rgya mtsho dga' ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ */ma rig 'khrul pa'i bser bus rab bskyod nas// ngan 'gro byin za'i bstir med kyis gdungs rnams// phan bde'i mkha' la thub pa'i shar thig gis// bsil phreng 'od brgya spro la gus phyag 'tshal// skal bzang blo ldan rkang drug gzhon nu rnams// myos ldan mngar ba'i ro la ma sems par// 'dab brgya bzhad byed gtsug dgu'i zil mngar gyi// lag len bā dhu'i dga' ston spel gyi longs// las nyon shes sgrib kyis mnar ba'i gang zag bdag cag rnams dang*/ lnga par gyur pa'i lus can bar ma dor 'khyams pa'i skal ngan rnams gnas ngan len de dang de dag las thar bar bgyi ba'i phyir/ sbyong rgyud gtsug dgu'i cho ga slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyi zhal snga nas bstsal ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba de'i rjes su 'brangs shing*/ de nyid rnal 'byor rgyud du bzhugs pa la rung mthun du gshin po rjes 'dzin dang 'brel ba dag gang zag dbang po rigs gsum thun mong gi don du mdor bsdus shing*/ rtogs sla ba'i tshul gyis brjod pa ni 'di lta ste/ lam 'di nyid la mos shing rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las 'di'i dbang bskur legs par mnos shing*/ gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa'i lag len man ngag dang bcas pa la 'ol tshod dang gzu lum du ma gyur pa'i nges pa brtan po thob par byas te/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi yo byad gshin gson rjes 'dzin skabs su bab pa gang dag de'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa 'du byas shing*/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma chus sbyangs la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pa'i spro ba dang ldan pas/

phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa gzugs brnyan gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang ro gcig par nges par byas nas 'od gsal bar rab tu zhugs pa'i ngang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pa/ sbom zhing thung ba stag lpags kyi smad dkris can dor stabs kyis pad nyi'i gdan la gnas par gyur par dmigs te/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mche ba kha'i zur du 'dzin pa'i rgyas| oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ thal mo khong stong gis rgyas| oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par dmigs te/ pad+ma kha bye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ pad kor dang 'gugs pa'i rgyas/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ pad kor gdan dbul ba'i rgyas/ gong gi sngags kyi sa pa riwā ra'i mjug tu/ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes gong gi sngags mjug tu/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ swā hā/ gsum brjod/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod la/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi// dkyil 'khor don du bstsal du gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// khyod rnams gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid nga*// nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che// nga ni stobs chen rdo rje can// nga ni rnal 'byor dbang phyu+ug rgyal// phyag na rdo rje brtan pa nga*// nga ni bdag po rdo rje che// byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'dor ro// zhes brjod cing gtor ma gtsang sar dor/

slar yang khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ gang su dag dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa phyogs su gnas pa'i lha klu la sogs pa sa'i bdag po khyod rnams myur du dengs shig /sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ slob ma'am/ tshe las 'das pa 'di'am/ bdag cag gis mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa rdzogs par bya ba'i don du bcom ldan 'das ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po brtsam par bya'o// de'i phyir rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' thos nas myur du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de'i mgo bo bdag gi khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar ba gsor zhing*/ rab tu gsor ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'dis rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes gsum mam gcig brjod cing*/ lus ngag yid la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs kun yang dag nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bka' yi 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni// lus gsum las byung 'gas par byed// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'// 'dir ni 'jigs 'gyur gzhan du min// zhes dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad do// mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las| bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa/ chos dbyings rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs la/

so so'i rgya 'og nas bshad pa ltar pad kor dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ pu+uṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs| |tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das ngan song sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis spyan drangs par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod nas/ gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du// ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams// thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni// cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*// byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras sgrub// snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs// rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yis// bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*// sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi// dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// 'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing*// snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan// rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i// brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas// sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin// lhag par mos pa'i rnam par brgyan pa yis// sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu// sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul// rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos// yang dag nyid du bdag nyid gnas par bgyi// zhes gsum gyis tshogs gnyis bsags la/

tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying khar thim par gyur par dmigs la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba bla na med pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces gsum brjod cing don dran pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ khams gsum po thams cad rang gi sems nyid kyi rnam par rol pa las ma 'das pa nyid des na de'i ngo bo rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa stong zhing bdag med par gyur/ oṃ tsit+ta bi ta be taṅka ro mi/ sdig pa dag pa'i dkyil 'khor che// nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med// gnas ngan len gyi gnas las grol// rtog pa kun las rab tu grol// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ tsit+ta pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes theg pa bla med kyi sngags su sems bskyed cing don dran par bya'o// de'i ngang nas thun mong gi srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og gi mthar thug cing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ sa 'og nas steng gi bar du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ steng du rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba dang 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bres brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i gur te/ thams cad kyang sra zhing mkhregs la bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'od zer 'khrugs par gyur/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor ni/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad nyir 'khor lo ser po rtsibs phyogs mtshams dang*/ steng 'og gnyis te bcu pa'i shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal 'di nas bzung sku mdog ma smos pa thams cad rtsa zhal gyi mdog gis bstan cing*/

rtsa zhal yang mdog thog mar gang smos ba de nyid rtsa zhal dang*| bar du smos pa g.yas zhal/ tha mar smos pa g.yon zhal gyis mdog tu bstan par rigs par bya'o// phyag 'og ma bzhi rdo rje'i tho ba/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ nor bu/ 'khor lo/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ mer 'dod rgyal sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ lcags kyu/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ srin por dbyug sngon can nag dkar dmar pa'i zhal/ dbyug pa/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ rlung du stobs chen nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ rtse gsum/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor sgyur ser sngo dmar ba'i zhal/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ nor bu/ pad+ma/ thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ gtsug tor 'dod rgyal mi g.yo ba gnod mdzes bzhi| rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing bsgyings pa mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa'i khro tshul sma ra dang bcas pa'o// gzhan drug ni mi sdug pa'i gzugs can sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche gtsigs ljags 'dril gad rgyangs dang bcas pa klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing sbom thung gsus pa 'phyang ba bcu ka'ang zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis rtsibs la ma reg tsam du pad nyi'i gdan la gnas pa/ sku la ye shes kyi me 'od bskal me ltar 'bar ba rang gi sprul pa dpag tu med pas kyang khams gsum pa'i bgegs tshogs ma lus pa brlag par byed pa/

'khor lo'ang rgyun mi 'chad par g.yas skor gyis drag tu 'khor zhing 'bar ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'o/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha dz+wa la ā na na wa di sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor gyi rim pa rten dang brten par bcas pa bsgom pa ni/ de lta bu'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po nam mkha'i tshul can 'og phra zhing steng yangs pa la gnas pa'i rlung me chu sa'i ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi rwa rnams dang*/ dbus de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i kha dog can/ de'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i phyi nas dkar sngo dmar ljang ser ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po la zur gsum dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ zlum po'i nor bus spras pa/ de'i steng du dra ba'i snam bu gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa nor bu dang dril bu rnga yab kyis mdzes par 'phyang ba/ do shal gyi nang du pad zla dang nyi ma rin po che phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po ril ba mgo thur du bstan pa lta bu/ de'i steng gi phyogs rnams su pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la rin po che'i bum par gnas pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan brgyad kyi rtse mor seng ge dang mkha' lding sogs kyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis skyod pa'i tshe sum khugs su 'khyog cing dril chung gi sgra 'khrol ba/ mda' yab kyi grwa bzhir rin po che'i gdugs bzhis mdzes pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i stegs bu rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin can gyis grwa dang sgo dang*/

sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras shing mchod pa'i lha mo du mas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud cing mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu gser dang shar bu rin chen rmig pa mun pa wa raṇ+ḍa mun pa shar bu rin po che rmig pa kra ma shir+ṣa ste/ snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i nang gi gu ṇa ha ri'i phyogs kyi mdog can la rnam par bkra ba'i bla bre dang do shal/ phyi rol du sna tshogs pa'i dar dpyangs dang rnga yab ba dan dang rgyal mtshan/ steng du pad zla la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags gser mdog pho mo 'gram pa bteg pa'i mig gis 'khor lo'i rtse mo la lta ba/ de dag gi 'khor du spre'us bzung ba'i zla tshes rdo rje'i rtse mo can gyi gdugs dkar dmar rnams kyis mdzes pa/ rta babs kyi gzhogs rnams su bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing*/ rin po che sna bdun gyi spras pas brgyan pa'i bar bar du grub pa thob pa rnams dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba sprin gyi sbubs nas byung ba'i lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mngon par dga' ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba phyogs kyi mdog can brgyad brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i thog gi dbus byur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'i nang du/ cha chen gcig gi khyams dang lha snam de'i nang du cha phran re re'i 'od phreng lnga dang*/ rdor phreng sngon pos bskor ba'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad dang*/ lte ba gser gyi mdog can/ lha snam gyi phyi'i khyams dang sgo'i nang gi g.yas g.yon du bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser bum gnyis gnyis kyis kun nas mdzes pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol du khor yug dkar po/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba dang*/

de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog sna tshogs 'khrugs pa'i zer phreng phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og kun tu 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// spro dang sdud pa'i byed pa po// ye shes skad cig gis rdzogs pa// rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// shin tu gser gyi mdog can 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs dang ldan pa chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ snyan rgyan dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ se mo do dang*/ ska rags dang*/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs dbang por rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po g.yas sa gnon/ gshin rjer rin chen gtsug tor sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin/ chur pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po g.yas mnyam bzhag |lus ngan du sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin te/ de bzhi ka'ang g.yon mnyam bzhag /mer gtsug tor gzi brjid dmar skya g.yas nyi ma dang g.yon dkur brten pa| srin por gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dkar nag 'dres pa nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ rlung du gtsug tor rnon po sngo bsangs g.yas ral gri dang g.yon po ti/ dbang ldan du gtsug tor gdugs dkar dkar po gdugs/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// rdor phreng gi phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir/ mer sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dkur brten pa/

srin por phreng ba ma ser po rin po che'i phreng ba/ rlung du glu ma dmar mo pi wang bsgrengs pa/ dbang ldan du gar ma sna tshogs mdog rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bzung nas gar byed pa/ lha snam gyi shar stod du byams pa ser po g.yas klu shing gi me tog dang g.yon spyi blugs/ mthong ba don yod ser po spyan gyis spras pa'i pad+ma/ shar smad du ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis lcags kyu/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges 'joms blo gros ser skya dbyug pa/ lho stod du spos glang ljang dkar dri'i dung chos/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dkar po ral gri/ lho smad du nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser pad+mar gnas pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ ye shes tog sngon po nor bu'i rgyal mtshan| nub stod du bdud rtsi 'od dkar po cod pan gyi steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ zla 'od dkar po pad+mar gnas pa'i zla ba/ nub smad du bzang skyong dkar po rin po che 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po rdo rje'i gur/ byang stod du rdo rje snying po sngo skya rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ut+pal/ blo gros mi zad pa dkar po phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ byang smad du spobs pa brtsegs pa dmar po pad+mar gnas pa'i rin po che'i brtsegs pa/ kun bzang gser mdog rin po che'i snye ma bsnams pa rnams so// de dag gi byams pa/ ngan song kun 'dren/ blo gros mi zad pa gsum ma gtogs bcu gsum po thams cad g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon dkur brten pa/ lha snam de dag gi mer me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi phreng ba/ srin por bdug spos ma nag mo spos snod/ rlung du mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu/ dbang ldan du dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po rdo rje'i zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po rdo rje'i lcags sgrog

/byang sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu rdo rjes spras pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ de ltar lha nyer brgyad po thams cad kyang dar sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan can/ zhal gcig pa phyag dang spyan gnyis gnyis pa/ zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis zhi zhing 'dzum bag dang dul ba'i ngang tshul bzang pos gnas pa'o// phyi'i khor yug dkar po la dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du/ glang la mgrin pa sngon po dkar po mgron thabs 'di rnams slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'i tshe dang sgrub mchod sogs kyi dus ma gtogs 'phral chog bca' bde ba'i tshe sngon po nas mgron thabs kyi tshogs lnga bcu rtsa drug zhes pa'i bar/ sogs khong byas kyang 'gal ba med la/ yang bdag bskyed la mgron thabs med pa dang mdun bskyed la yod par byas kyang 'thus so// la sogs pa de ltar mgron thabs kyi tshogs lnga bcu rtsa drug po phyogs re rer bcu bzhi re gnas shing*/ de dag gi lha rnams ni phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse gsum pa thogs pa/ lha min rnams ni mdog sna tshogs go cha sna tshogs bgos shing ral gri 'dzin pa ras bal gyi stan 'jam pa la gnas pa/ klu rnams ni nor bu dang ldan pa'i gdengs ka can btsun mor bcas shing bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i ye shes me'i phyi rol gyi mer mnar med la sogs pa'i dmyal ba rnams dang*/ srin por yi dwags rnams dang*/ rlung du dud 'gro rnams dang*/ dbang ldan du mi'i 'gro ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ de ltar gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par mos la/

rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i| |bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyong zhing*// smon lam rgya che dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod la spyan drangs nas dngos su byon te mdun du bzhugs par dmigs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod tshogs bzhes slad du| |ji srid 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ mgron thabs rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas nas 'ongs te rang rang gi dam tshig pa la thim/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ zhes brjod la bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas dbang rdzas so so bsnams nas/

oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ra badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsaḥ.āḥ/ oṃ bud+dha badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes rigs dbang lnga/ chu'i bya ba rjes 'gro dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la thim chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las gtso bo la rang nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rnam snang*/ rdo rje gtsug tor sogs bzhi la rnam snang chen po rtsa ba'i lha/ shar dang me'i lha rnams rdo rje gtsug tor/ lho dang bden bral gyi lha rnams rin chen gtsug tor/ nub dang rlung gi lha rnams pad+ma gtsug tor/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi lha rnams sna tshogs gtsug tor/ khor yug gi mgron thabs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces mos la/ mchod pa gsar pa bsham mam rnying pa kha gsos par sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mche ba kha'i zur du 'dzin pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ thal mo khong stong gi rgyas/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa ngo bo stong pa byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa chos dbyings rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs la/ so so'i rgya 'og nas bshad pa ltar pad kor dang bcas pas/

oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs te/ rnam dag yid du 'ong ba'i zhabs bsil 'di// rnam kun mchog ldan rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// rnam pa kun tu dad pas bdag dbul gyi// rnam 'dren go 'phang dam pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ bsang gtor| prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ 'thor 'thung*/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ mchod yon/ ar+ghaṃ/ me tog /puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos/ dhū paṃ/ mar me/ ā lo kaṃ dri chab/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ sgra snyan/ shapad/ zhes rkang pa dang po'i zhabs bsil gyi gnas su bsang gtor zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ de bzhin rang rang gi sngags rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ rdor dril 'dzin cing rigs lnga'i rgya dang bcas pas bstod pa ni/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar bya ba'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa| |ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rje'i thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can las kyi chu bor nub pa la// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi| |zhes bstod// bzlas pa ni/

'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su muṃ gyi mthar mtshan sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa 'khor bcas mchod pas mnyes par byas shing*/ slar spros pas sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gsum bag chags gnas ngan len gyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung gi tshogs dang*/ rigs drug sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba thams cad sbyangs te zhi bar byas/ slar yang 'od kyis reg pas sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya seng ge rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod nas/ de rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi gdul bya nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i 'gro ba rnams la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad pas de rnams kyang shākya seng ge'i go 'phang la 'god nus pa'i skal pa can du gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni swā hā/ thub pa thub pa thub pa chen po legs par byin/ zhes gtso bo'i mtshan sngags brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung sogs skabs dus kyi long dang bstun la bzlas so// 'khor gyi bzlas pa ni/ rtsa ba'i lha so so'i thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su rang rang gi mtshan yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro ba'i don tshad med pa byas/ slar 'dus rang rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ oṃ rat+noṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ rin chen gtsug tor/ oṃ pad+moṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ pad+ma gtsug tor/ oṃ bi shwoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ sna tshogs gtsug tor/ oṃ te dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ gtsug tor gzi brjid/ oṃ dh+wa dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ gtsug tor rgyal mtshan/ oṃ tik+ṣa ṇoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ gtsug tor rnon po/ oṃ tshā tra shwe toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar/

oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje sgeg mo/ oṃ badz+ra mā le hūm̐/ rdo rje phreng ba ma/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūm̐/ rdo rje glu ma/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje gar ma/ oṃ mai tri hūm̐/ byams pa/ oṃ a mo gha dṛṣ+ṭa hūm̐/ mthong ba don yod/ oṃ durga ta sarba nā ya ka haṃ'u/ ngan song kun 'dren/ oṃ durga la ni s+sa ra ṇa hūm̐/ mya ngan kun 'joms/ oṃ gan+dha hasti hūm̐/ spos glang*/ oṃ shu raṃ ga mo hūm̐/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ oṃ ga ga na ko ṣa hūm̐/ nam mkha' mdzod/ oṃ dzñā na ke tu hūm̐/ ye shes tog /oṃ a mṛ ta pra bha hūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i 'od/ oṃ tsan+d+ra pra bha hūm̐/ zla ba'i 'od/ oṃ su pā la hūm̐/ bzang skyong*/ oṃ dzā li ni pra bha hūm̐/ dra ba can gyi 'od/ oṃ ga ya garbaha hūm̐/ rdo rje snying po/ oṃ ak+ṣa ya ma ti hūm̐/ blo gros mi zad pa/ oṃ pra ti bhān ku ṭa hūm̐/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐/ kun tu bzang po/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ rdo rje me tog ma/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ rdo rje bdug spos ma/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ rdo rje snang gsal ma/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐| rdo rje dri chab ma/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ rdo rje zhags pa ma/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya hoḥ rdo rje 'bebs pa/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa brgya stong sogs ci rigs pa bzlas so// de nas gtso 'khor thams cad thun mong du rtsa ba'i rig pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+yathā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/

shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes mang du bzla/ khor yug gi mgron thabs so so'i thugs kar rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa re re gsal bar gyur par dmigs te/ rtsa rig ci 'grub bzla bar bya'o// de dag ni bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/// / ༈ /gnyis pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ gser dngul zangs la sogs pa las grub pa'i bum pa tshad dang ldan pa rab lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ 'bring gtsug dgu las bum dang bcas pa/ tha ma gtso bum dang las thams cad pa ste de ltar gang 'dzom yang gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs te bgegs bskrad la/ 'o ma dang bsres pa'i chus sum gnyis dgang la lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang ldan pa 'bras can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ dar dmar ram/ ser po'am/ dkar po gang rung gi mgul chings/ rnam rgyal la ze prog dgu bdun lnga sogs dang las thams cad pa la ze prog gsum gnyis gang rung can nam/ yang na gnyis ka kha tshar ma nyams pa'i ras zung gis mgul dkris pa'i steng du hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar pos lan bdun dkris la/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa ma ṭa di shaṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐/ rdo rje rtse mos phyogs rnams chings chings/ zhes dkris la rnam rgyal bum pa la gur gum sogs dri'i chus rtsa lha rnams kyi sa bon nam/ rigs lnga'i sa bon nam/ zla ba'i lte bar muṃ dang*/ las thams cad pa la nyi ma'i dbus su k+ṣaṃ bris pa dag rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang las thams cad pa shar sgo'i g.yon nam yang na slob dpon gyi nye logs su mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ rnam rgyal gtso bo yin pa dang bya ba mang ba'i phyir rnam rgyal gyi steng du lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas kyis sbags pa'i dri chu/ oṃ badz+ro a mṛ tod ka ṭha hūm̐/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin dang ldan par gyur/

ces brjod cing dung chos sam pad snod du bstsal ba rnam rgyal gyi steng du bkod pa 'di la rgyal ba'i bum pa zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang 'dogs so// de'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ kha dog lnga ldan gyi srad bu btags pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis bsngags pa bzhag la/ bum pa gnyis bsangs gzi sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ mgrin pa ring zhing lto ba ldir la zhabs zhum pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa 'bras can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa lha'i gos bzang pos bklubs pa gnyis kyi nang du oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ dros ma dros ma cher dros ma/ zhes bya bas drangs pa'i lha'i gaṅgā'i chu'i ngo bos gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du lha snam gru bzhi pa'i lte bar 'od phreng lnga dang*/ rdo rje sngon po'i ra ba'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa gser mdog lta bu'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i khri'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po shin tu gser gyi mdog can 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs dang ldan pa/ chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ snyan rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ se mo do dang*/ ska rags dang*/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs dbang por rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po g.yas sa gnon/ gshin rjer rin chen gtsug tor sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin/ chur pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po g.yas mnyam bzhag /lus ngan du sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin te/ de bzhi ka'ang g.yon mnyam bzhag /mer gtsug tor gzi brjid dmar skya g.yas nyi ma dang g.yon dkur brten pa/ srin por gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dkar nag 'dres pa nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/

rlung du gtsug tor rnon po sngo sangs g.yas ral gri dang g.yon po ti/ dbang ldan du gtsug tor gdugs dkar dkar po gdugs/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// rdor phreng gi phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi'i mer sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dkur brten pa/ srin por phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba/ rlung du glu ma dmar mo pi wang bsgrengs pa/ dbang ldan du gar ma sna tshogs mdog rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bzung nas gar byed pa/ lha snam gyi shar stod du byams pa ser po g.yas klu shing gi me tog dang g.yon spyi blugs/ mthong ba don yod ser po spyan gyis spras pa'i pad+ma/ shar smad du ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis lcags kyu/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges 'joms blo gros ser skya dbyug pa/ lho stod du spos glang ljang dkar dri'i dung chos/ dpa' par 'gro ba dkar po ral gri/ lho smad du nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser pad+mar gnas pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ ye shes tog sngon po nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub stod du bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar po cod pan gyi steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ zla 'od dkar po pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba/ nub smad du bzang skyong dkar po rin po che 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po rdo rje'i gur/ byang stod du rdo rje snying po sngo skya rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ut+pal/ blo gros mi zad pa dkar po phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ byang smad du spobs pa brtsegs pa dmar po pad+mar gnas pa'i rin po che'i brtsegs pa/ kun bzang gser mdog rin po che'i snye ma bsnams pa rnams so// de dag gi byams pa/ ngan song kun 'dren/ blo gros mi zad pa gsum ma gtogs bcu gsum po thams cad g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon dkur brten pa/

lha snam de dag gi mer me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi phreng ba/ srin por bdug spos ma nag mo spos snod/ rlung du mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu/ dbang ldan du dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos/ shar du rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ lho ru rdo rje zhags pa ser po rdo rje'i zhags pa/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po rdo rje'i lcags sgrog /byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu rdo rjes spras pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ de ltar lha nyer brgyad po thams cad kyang dar sna tshogs pa'i gos dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan can zhal gcig pa phyag dang spyan gnyis gnyis pa zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis zhi zhing 'dzum bag dang dul ba'i ngang tshul bzang pos gnas pa'o// bum mtshan rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das ngan song sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu rtsa ba'i lha rnams sku mdog rgyan cha lugs gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i nang du pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po khro bo'i cha lugs can sbom thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing ral pa brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris pa phyag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dang bcas pas khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pa sems skyil gyis bzhugs par gyur| bum mtshan yang rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi skur skad cig gis gsal bar gyur ces mos/ de ltar gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes mos la/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyong zhing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral bya'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod la spyan drangs nas dngos su byon te mdun du bzhugs par mos la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod tshogs bzhes slad du// ji srid 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas dbang rdzas so so bsnams nas/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ra badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ bud+dha badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes rigs dbang lnga/ chu'i bya ba rjes 'gro dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la thim chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las gtso bo la rang nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rnam snang*/ rdo rje gtsug tor sogs bzhi la rnam snang chen po rtsa ba'i lha/ shar dang me'i lha rnams rdo rje gtsug tor/ lho dang bden bral gyi lha rnams rin chen gtsug tor/ nub dang rlung gi lha rnams pad+ma gtsug tor/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi lha rnams dang las thams cad pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin sna tshogs gtsug tor gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces mos la/ mchod pa gsar du bsham mam rnying pa kha gsos te/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mche ba kha'i zur du 'dzin pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/

thal mo khong stong gi rgyas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa chos dbyings rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs la/ so so'i rgya 'og nas bshad pa ltar pad kor dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam sprul lha mo zhabs bsil ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mchod phyir 'bul| |rdo rje zhabs bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ bsang gtor/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ 'thor 'thung*/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ mchod yon/ ar+ghaṃ/ me tog /puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos/ dhū paṃ/ mar me/ ā lo kaṃ/ dri chab/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ sgra snyan/ shapad/ zhes zhabs bsil gyi gnas su bsang gtor zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ de bzhin rang rang gi sngags rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ rdor dril 'dzin cing rigs lnga'i rgya dang bcas pas bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// ces sogs kyis bstod/

las thams cad pa la/ so sor kun rtog phrin las bdag /rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag /phyag gnyis rdo rje mche ba 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la// zhes bstod cing bum mtshan rnams kyang sngar bskyed pa lta bu'i lhar mos la/ hūm̐ brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me tog gi phreng bas spras pa'i gzung thag g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar so so'i mtshan sngags kyis bskor ba la rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa gzung thag la brgyud de song ba so so'i thugs kar reg pas sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ slar 'dus te so sor thim zhing sa bon dang sngags phreng so so nas bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs nas/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni swā hā/ gtso bo'i sngags 'di brgya stong khri 'bum ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+rod ka hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bzla/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+noṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+moṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ bi shwoṣ+ṇīṣa hūm̐/ oṃ te dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ dh+wa dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ tik+ṣa ṇoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ tshā tra shwe toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐| oṃ mai tri hūm̐/ oṃ a mo gha dṛṣ+ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ durga ta sarba nā ya ka hūm̐/ oṃ durga la ni s+sa ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ gan+dha hasti hūm̐/ oṃ shu raṃ ga mo hūm̐/ oṃ ga ga na ko ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na ke tu hūm̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ tsan+d+ra pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ su pā la hūm̐/ oṃ dzā li ni pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ ga ya garbaha hūm̐/ oṃ ak+ṣa ya ma ti hūm̐/ oṃ pra ti bhān ku ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya hoḥ zhes pa brgya stong sogs ci rigs bzlas so| |de nas gtso 'khor thams cad thun mong du rtsa ba'i rig pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+yathā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes brgya stong sogs ci rigs pa bzlas so// de nas las thams cad pa la dmigs te/ gzung thag rdo rje de'i steng du spos la/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od phreng gzung thag la brgyud de rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su k+ṣaṃ gi mthar mtshan sngags kyis bskor ba la reg pas phrin las thams cad sgrub par gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes ci 'grub bzla'o// rdo rje'i las sngags bzlas pa'i me tog dkar po gsum rnam rgyal gyi lha la mchod nas bsrung ba'i don du las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i bum chus 'thor zhing bsangs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rab mchog bsnyen bkur ba'i mchod yon so sor bzhes/ zhes dung chos kyi mchod yon rnam rgyal gyi lha la phul nas/ lha rnams byang chub sems kyi bde ba chen pos zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ bum mtshan lhar gyur pa rnams kyang slar bum mtshan gyi rnam par gyur/ ces mos la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ bsang gtor gyi don du bum pa gnyis kyi chu cung zad re dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa'i bsang gtor gyi nang du bsre zhing*/

dung chos su rnam rgyal gyi chu cung zad slar blugs pa rnam rgyal gyi steng du bkod pa bzhag ste dbang gi tshe mna' chu'i ched du bya bar gsungs so/ /de dag ni bum pa bzlas pa'i rim pa dag go/// / ༈ /de nas mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ rdul tshon bgyi bar spro na sa brtag pa nas bzung dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i bar rnams lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma ltar bya zhing 'dir ras bris kyi dbang du byas te/ de'ang ras bris kyi mthar mchod pa'i bye brag dgod pa dang*/ slob ma'am/ tshe 'das rjes 'dzin/ sbyin sreg /rab gnas sogs gang yin gyi yo byad rnams chad lhag dang nor 'khrul 'od tshod spangs te 'du bya zhing*/ de dag gshom pa'i tshe'ang rgyud kyi dgongs pa mthong rgyud lag len gyis brgyan pa kho na las rang bzo dang spyi brtol spangs nas bkod legs par bshams la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor las thams cad pa'i oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la sogs kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su chos 'byung dkar po nam mkha'i tshul can 'og phra zhing steng yangs pa la gnas pa'i rlung me chu sa'i ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi rwa rnams dang*/ dbus de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i kha dog can/ de'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i phyi nas dkar sngo dmar ljang ser ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po la zur gsum dang gru bzhi dang zlum po'i nor bus spras pa/ de'i steng du dra ba'i snam bu gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa nor bu dang dril bu rnga yab kyis mdzes par 'phyang ba/

do shal gyi nang du pad zla dang nyi ma rin po ches phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po ril pa mgo thur du bstan pa lta bu/ de'i steng gi phyogs rnams su pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la rin po che'i bum par gnas pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad kyi rtse mor seng ge dang mkha' lding sogs kyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis skyod pa'i tshe sum khugs su 'khyog cing dril chung gi sgra 'khrol ba/ mda' yab kyi grwa bzhir rin po che'i gdugs bzhis mdzes pa rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i stegs bu rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin can gyi grwa dang sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras shing mchod pa'i lha mo du mas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud cing mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka ba bzhis bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu gser dang shar bu rin chen rmig pa mun pa wa raṇ+ḍa mun pa shar bu rin po che rmig pa kra ma shir+ṣa ste/ snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i nang gi gu ṇa ha ri phyogs kyi mdog can la rnam par bkra ba'i bla bre dang do shal/ phyi rol du sna tshogs pa'i dar dpyangs dang rnga yab ba dan dang rgyal mtshan steng du pad zla la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags gser mdog pho mo 'gram pa bteg pa'i mig gis 'khor lo'i rtse mo la blta ba de dag gi 'khor du spre'us bzung ba'i zla tshes rdo rje rtse mo can gyi gdugs dkar dmar rnams kyis mdzes pa/ rta babs kyi gzhogs rnams su bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing rin po che sna bdun gyis spras pas brgyan pa'i bar bar du grub pa thob pa rnams dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba sprin gyi sbubs nas byung ba'i lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mngon par dga' ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du ka ba phyogs kyi mdog can brgyad brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i thog gi dbus byur bus gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'i nang du cha chen gcig gi khyams dang lha snam de'i nang du cha phran re re'i 'od phreng lnga dang*|

rdor phreng sngon pos bskor ba'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad dang lte ba gser gyi mdog can/ lha snam gyi phyi'i khyams kyi sgo'i nang gi g.yas g.yon du bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser bum gnyis gnyis kyis kun nas mdzes pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol du khor yug dkar po/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog sna tshogs 'khrugs pa'i zer phreng phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og kun tu 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma gnas pa'i seng ge'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po shin tu gser gyi mdog can 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs dang ldan pa/ chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ snyan rgyan dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ se mo do dang*/ ska rags dang*/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs dbang por rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po g.yas sa gnon/ gshin rjer rin chen gtsug tor sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin/ chur pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po g.yas mnyam bzhag /lus ngan du sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin te/ de bzhi ka'ang g.yon mnyam bzhag /mer gtsug tor gzi brjid dmar skya g.yas nyi ma g.yon dkur brten pa/ srin por gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dkar nag 'dres pa nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ rlung du gtsug tor rnon po sngo sangs g.yas ral gri dang g.yon po ti/ dbang ldan du gtsug tor gdugs dkar dkar po gdugs| thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' mdzes pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// rdor phreng gi phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi'i mer sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dkur brten pa/

srin por phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba/ rlung du glu ma dmar mo pi wang bsgrengs pa/ dbang ldan du gar ma sna tshogs mdog rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bzung nas gar byed pa/ lha snam gyi shar stod du byams pa ser po g.yas klu shing gi me tog dang g.yon spyi blugs/ mthong ba don yod ser po spyan gyis spras pa'i pad+ma/ shar smad du ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis lcags kyu/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges 'joms blo gros ser skya dbyug pa/ lho stod du spos glang ljang dkar dri'i dung chos/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dkar po ral gri/ lho smad du nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser pad+mar gnas pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ ye shes tog sngon po nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub stod du bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar po cod pan gyi steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ zla 'od dkar po pad+mar gnas pa'i zla ba/ nub smad du bzang skyong dkar po rin po che 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po rdo rje'i gur/ byang stod du rdo rje snying po sngo skya rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ut+pal/ blo gros mi zad pa dkar po phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ byang smad du spobs pa brtsegs pa dmar po pad+mar gnas pa'i rin po che brtsegs pa/ kun bzang gser mdog rin po che'i snye ma bsnams pa rnams so// de dag gi byams pa/ ngan song kun 'dren/ blo gros mi zad pa gsum ma gtogs bcu gsum po thams cad g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon dkur brten pa/ lha snam de dag gi mer me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi phreng ba/ srin por bdug spos ma nag mo spos snod/ rlung du mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu/ dbang ldan du dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po rdo rje'i zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po rdo rje'i lcags sgrog

/byang sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu rdo rjes spras pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ de ltar lha brgyad po thams cad kyang dar sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan can zhal gcig pa phyag dang spyan gnyis gnyis pa zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis zhi zhing 'dzum bag dang dul ba'i ngang tshul bzang pos gnas pa'o// phyi'i khor yug dkar po la dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du| glang la mgrin pa sngon po dkar po mchod phyir thogs pa can phyag bzhir rdo rje/ mchog sbyin/ rtse gsum/ ral gri/ mkha' lding la khyab 'jug nag po dang gser gyi rdo rje ma gser mdog gnyis ka phyag bzhir dbyug to/ rdo rje/ dung*/ 'khor lo/ rma bya la rdo rje dril bu dang rdo rje gzhon nu ma dmar mo zhal drug phyag bzhir shak+ti/ rdo rje/ khyim bya/ dril bu/ ngang pa la mi smra rdo rje zhi ba ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag bzhir rdo rje/ mda' phreng*/ dbyug pa/ spyi blugs/ glang chen dkar po mche ba drug pa la rdo rje mtshon cha dang zla ba la rdo rje khu tshur ma dkar mo rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pas gnas pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon rdo rje dkur brten pa/ rta bdun gyi shing rta la rdo rje 'khyil ba khro bo dang rdo rje bdud rtsi ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon pad nyi/ ngang pa la rdo rje 'od khro bo dang rdo rje mdog ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon pad zla/ ra skyes la rdo rje dmar ser khro bo dang rdo rje ska rags ma dmar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon mi bzung nas za tshul/ pad+ma la rdo rje zhi ba khro bo dang rdo rje zhi ba ma ser mo mda' dang gzhu/ sbal pa la rdo rje khro bo bla ma dang rdo rje bla ma ma ser mo bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs/ pad ma la rdo rje pa wa sangs khro bo dang rdo rje pa wa sangs ma dkar mo bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs/ rus sbal la rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo dang rdo rje dbyug pa ma nag mo rdo rje dang dbyug pa/

rdo rje sgra gcan khro bo dang rdo rje lha min ma dmar nag zla ba dang nyi ma/ rdo rje mjug ring khro bo dang rdo rje glu ma nag mo ral gri dang sbrul zhags/ glang chen la rdo rje glang sna dang rdo rje 'dul ba ma dkar mo rdo rje dang thong gshol yum gyi g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ/ bya ko ki la'i shing rta la rdo rje phreng ba can dang rdo rje gdan ma ljang gu rdo rje dang yab ky-i g.yon me tog gi phreng ba dang yum gyi mdung thung*/ ne tso'i shing rta la rdo rje dbang can ser po dang rdo rje dbang can ma dmar mo rdo rje dang chu srin rgyal mtshan/ sbal pa la rnam par rgyal ba dang rdo rje gdan ma dkar po rdo rje dang ral gri/ me tog la rdo rje gtun shing dang rdo rje pho nya mo ser mo g.yas rdo rje dang*/ yab kyi g.yon gtun shing dang*/ yum gyi g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ra skyes la rdo rje me dang rdo rje 'bar ba ma dmar mo phyag bzhir rdo rje/ go cha/ dbyug to/ spyi blugs/ ma he la rdo rje dus nag po rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ ro langs la rdo rje nag mo nag po rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ/ klu lhag ma can la rdo rje lcags kyu sngon po phag zhal can rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ mi la rdo rje gdong ma sngon mo phag zhal can rdo rje dang ral gri/ chu srin la rdo rje klu dang rdo rje chu srin ma dkar mo sbrul mgo brgyad ldan g.yas rdo rje dang*/ yab kyi g.yon klu zhags dang*/ yum gyi g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i chu srin/ ri dwags la rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje shugs can ma sngon mo rdo rje dang rlung sgrib pa'i gos/ ro langs la rdo rje 'jigs byed dang rdo rje rnam brtsegs ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje dang*/ yab kyi g.yon dbyug to dang*/ yum gyi g.yon zhags pa/ byi ba la rdo rje log 'dren dkar po glang po'i gdong can sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa phyag bzhir rdo rje/ dgra sta/ rtse gsum/

dbyug to/ bra ba byi ba la rdo rje srul mo sngon mo rdo rje dang phyag shing*/ sdig ma ljang mo rdo rje dang ral gri phe ṭa ka /dpal mo ser mo rdo rje dang pad+ma/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo rdo rje dang pi wang*/ seng ge la bgrod dka' ma ljang gu phyag bzhir rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ lde man/ ral gri/ nub tu rdo rje klu dang nye bar pad+ma la gnas pa'i sa'i lha mo gser mdog bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ de ltar mgron thabs kyi tshogs lnga bcu rtsa drug po phyogs re rer bcu bzhi re gnas shing*/ de dag gi lha rnams ni phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse gsum pa thogs pa/ lha min rnams ni mdog sna tshogs go cha sna tshogs bgos shing ral gri 'dzin pa ras bal gyi stan 'jam pa la gnas pa/ klu rnams ni nor bu dang ldan pa'i gdengs ka can btsun mor bcas shing bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i ye shes me'i phyi rol gyi mer mnar med la sogs pa'i dmyal ba rnams dang*/ srin por yi dwags rnams dang*/ rlung du dud 'gro rnams dang*/ dbang ldan du mi'i 'gro ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ de ltar gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par mos la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyong zhing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyod bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod la/

spyan drangs nas dngos su byon te mdun du bzhugs par dmigs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod tshogs bzhes slad du// ji srid 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ mgron thabs rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas nas 'ongs te rang rang gi dam tshig pa la thim/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ zhes brjod la bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs| oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas dbang rdzas so sor bsnams nas/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ra badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ bud+dha badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes rigs dbang lnga/ chu'i bya ba rjes 'gro dang bcas pas dbang bskur| dbang gi lha rnams 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la thim/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las gtso bo la rang nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rnam snang*/ rdo rje gtsug tor sogs bzhi la rnam snang chen po rtsa ba'i lha/ shar dang me'i lha rnams rdo rje gtsug tor/ lho dang bden bral lha rnams rin chen gtsug tor/ nub dang rlung gi lha rnams pad+ma gtsug tor/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi lha rnams sna tshogs gtsug tor/ 'khor yug gi mgron thabs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/

ces mos la/ mchod pa gsar pa bsham/ rnying pa kha gsos par sngar ltar/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la sogs gzi byin bskyed/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa chos dbyings rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhe| nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros nas dngos su mchod par gyur par dmigs te/ thog mar chu bzhi ni| bdag mdun bum pa sogs kyi mchod pa chu bzhi nyer spyod rnams kyi so so'i rdzas sreg chog tu bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ rgyas par na chu bzhi la dung zhal dang bzed zhal sogs kyang bya dgos so// dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes khu tshur g.yas 'og tu phyogs pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi skam pas zhabs bsil gyi chu dang me tog dngos su len pa'am der mos te/ bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis sor mo rnams g.yas su bskor zhing 'og tu phyogs pas mdzub mo dang gung mo srin lag mthe'u chung rnams rim gyis bkrol nas bzed zhal du lan gsum dor ba'am/

de ltar mos la dngos su byed na g.yon pas de'i snod 'dzin cing*/ der mos na g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar zhing sor mo gzhan rnams brkyang ba dung zhal gyi rgya gyen du bstan pa bya dgos te/ g.yon pa'i rgya 'di ni chu bzhi kar rigs 'gre'o// de ltar zhabs bsil ni lha thams cad zhabs bkru ba'i ched du'o// de bzhin du rkang pa gnyis pa'i mtha'i zhabs bsil gyi gnas su/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*| mchod yon/ zhes bcug cing*/ pā d+yaṃ gi gnas su/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ zhes bsgyur la/ lag g.yas ku sha'i rtse mos dri'i chu lan gsum 'thor tshul byed pa bsang gtor gyi phyag rgya ste sku la 'bul/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gan rkyal du byas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi skam pas chu dang bzed zhal du lan gsum 'bul lam 'bul tshul byed pa 'thor 'thung gi phyag rgya ste zhal lam phyag tu 'bul/ dung chos dngos su thogs pa'am lag g.yas kyang g.yon pa ltar byas te dung chos kyi rgyas bzed zhal du lan gsum 'bul lam de'i tshul byed pa mchod yon gyi phyag rgya ste mdun du 'bul/ de nas nyer spyod lnga ni/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sbub ste steng du phyogs pas me tog 'thor ba'i tshul te/ me tog 'bul lo// nags tshal las byung dri yi mchog /gang zhig dri yi bdug spos mchog /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// dhū paṃ= zhes rdo rje khu tshur gnyis thur du sbub pa spos bdug pa'i tshul bdug spos te mdun du'o// srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ā lo kaṃ=

zhes rdo rje khu tshur gyis mthe bong gnyis gshibs te sgreng zhing bskor ba mar me ste mdun du'o// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri// shangs la tshim byed dag pa 'di// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// gan+dhe= zhes rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brkyangs nas snying gar byug tshul ni dri chab ste thugs kar ro// lha bshos gtsang ma thams cad ni| |bza' dang bca' ba'i bye brag bcas// kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa// 'bul gyi so sor bzhes su gsol// nai wi d+ya= zhes thal mo gnyis brkyangs pa kha gyen du phyogs te mdun du bzhag pa lha bshos te zhal du'o// sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod| |shapad= rdo rje khu tshur gnyis pi wang rdung pa'i tshul lam rol mo bya'o// 'di thams cad la pad kor sngon du 'gro zhing rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya bstun la bya'o// de nas 'dod yon lnga ni/ yid 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gzugs kyi tshogs// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// snang stong mtha' bral ngang du grol bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes khu tshur g.yon pa'i steng du thal mo g.yas brkyangs te sgreng ba gzugs kyi rgya dang*/ zin dang ma zin sgra yi dbye ba kun// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// grag stong mtha' bral ngang du grol bar shog /shapad= zhes pi wang gi rgya'am rol mo dang*/ bsod dang mi bsod dri yi rnam pa kun// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// tshor stong mtha' bral ngang du grol bar shog /gan+dhe= dri'i rgya sngar ltar dang*/

ro drug ldan pa'i bshos gtsang bda' ba rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// myong stong mtha' bral ngang du grol bar shog /ra sa= lha bshos kyi rgya sngar ltar dang*/ dbang po'i gzhu 'dra'i gos bzang ji snyed pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// reg stong mtha' bral ngang du grol bar shog /spṛṣ+ṭa byaṃ= zhes rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis mtheb mdzub gnyis skam pa'i rgyas na bza' 'phyar nas dbul ba ltar ram dngos su 'bul/ de nas rgyal srid bdun ni/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas su// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo rin po che// dpag yas 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig dbul// 'khor los sgyur rgyal bla med brtan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du rkang pa gnyis pa'i tshig mtha'i 'khor lo'i mal du/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang po/ rta mchog/ dmag dpon/ zhes dang tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi/ s+t+rī/ gṛ ha pa ti/ hasti| tu raṃ ga a shwa/ se nā pa ti/ zhes dang lag gnyis mkhreg ma bsnol te rgyab sprad pa'i sor mo rnams gcig la gcig 'khyud cing mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug pa 'khor lo'i rgya/ khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis tshigs bcag ste brkyang ba rtse sprad mthe bong gshibs te bsgreng ba nor bu'i rgya/ rdor thal kha phye ba'i mdzub mo bkug nas gung mo mnyam pa'i rtse sprad pa rdor dbyings kyi dbang mo'i rgya/ khu tshur bsdams pa'i gung mo dang mthe'u chung so sor gshibs te rtse sprad pa brkyang ba blon po'i rgya/ lag g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag ste bsgrengs la g.yas khu tshur las gung po thur du glang po'i sna ltar brkyang ba glang po'i rgya/ khu tshur gnyis btsir ba'i gung mo dang srin lag so sor gshibs te brkyang ba mthe bong so sor rna ba ltar sgreng ba rta mchog gi rgya/

g.yon go cha 'dzin tshul dang*/ g.yas mchog sbyin byas pa dmag dpon gyi rgya rnams so// de nas sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las| |sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /sgeg mo rnam par chags pa'i nyams ldan mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra lā s+ye pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje khu tshur gnyis sta zur gnyis su bzhag pa sgeg mo'i rgya/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /sna tshogs nor bu'i phreng ba 'dzin mdzad mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā le pra tīts+tsha hūm̐// rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin ba'i rgya dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /snyan tshig bstod pa'i glu dbyangs mkhan dbang mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gī ti pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ g.yon phrag par pi wang gi rgyud sor mos gnon pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas khu tshur gyis gzhu thog nas bskul ba ltar byed pa glu ma'i rgya/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las| |sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /mig 'phrul mnga' ba'i sna tshogs gar mkhan mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra nṛt+yai pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis gar skor ba gar ma'i rgya/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /chu dang thang skyes 'dab ldan thogs mdzad mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/

sngar gyi me tog ma'i rgya dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /dri zhim lha yi spos phor 'dzin mdzad mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha ham̐'u/ bdug pa'i rgya/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /nyi zla'i 'od mtshungs mar me mchog 'dzin mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha hūm̐// mar me'i rgya/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol rab mdzes lha mo mchog /dri yi dung phor thogs nas byug mdzad mas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ dri'i rgya sngar ltar byas la dbul lo// de ltar mchod pa rnams rgyas pa la mi dga' na sngags dang phyag rgya tsam la brten pas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro// de nas bstod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas lha rang rang gi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya dang phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i tshe thal sbyar dang sho lo ka'i mgor dril bu gsil zhing bar bar du rdo rje'i gar bsgyur ba dang bcas pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa// khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun gyi// ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa// shākya seng ge khyod phyag 'tshal// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// rang gi de nyid ston mdzad pa// rdo rje gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal// mnyam pa'i de nyid sgom pa las// khams gsum la gnas thams cad dang*// dbang bskur rab tu stsol mdzad pa// rin chen gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal// so sor kun rtog rang bzhin las// chos kyi bdud rtsi char 'bebs pa// sems can dbugs 'byin mdzad pa po// pad+ma gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal// sems can sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir// bya ba rjes sgrub rang bzhin can// phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po// sna tshogs gtsug tor khyod phyag 'tshal// khams gsum 'od kyis gsal mdzad nas// sems can kun gyis 'phags pa yi// bden pa mthong bar mdzad pa po| |gtsug tor gzi brjid khyod phyag 'tshal// yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnams// sbyin pas sems can thams cad kyi// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// gtsug tor rgyal mtshan khyod phyag 'tshal// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag

/gcod cing bdud bzhi'i stobs bcom nas// sems can byang chub thob mdzad pa// gtsug tor rnon po khyod phyag 'tshal| |khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad kyi// gdugs dkar gyis ni brgyan pa yi// chos kyi rgyal po thob mdzad pa// gtsug tor gdugs dkar khyod phyag 'tshal/ sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu// gar ma lha mo bzhi po dang*// me tog spos dang mar me ma// dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal// dad sogs ngo bo las byung ba'i// sgo yi dbus na gang bzhugs pa// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// sgo srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgo bzhi yi ni logs dag dang*// khyams la sogs par bzhugs mdzad pa'i// rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad gang*// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal 'dud// tshangs dang drag po zla ba sogs// phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// me dang srin po rlung lha dang*// 'byung po'i bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// ces sogs kyis bstod nas/ bzlas pa ni/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su muṃ gyi mthar mtshan sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros 'phags pa 'khor bcas mchod pas mnyes par byas shing*/ slar spros pas sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gsum bag chags gnas ngan len gyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung gi tshogs dang*/ rigs drug sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba thams cad sbyangs te zhi bar byas/ slar yang 'od kyis reg pas sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya seng ge rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod nas/ de rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi gdul bya nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i 'gro ba rnams la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad pas/ de rnams kyang shākya seng ge'i go 'phang la 'god nus pa'i skal pa can du gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni swā hā/

zhes dang 'khor gyi bzlas pa ni/ rtsa ba'i lha so so'i thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su rang rang gi mtshan yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro ba'i don tshad med par byas/ slar 'dus rang rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+noṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+moṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ bi shwoṣ+ṇīṣa hūm̐/ oṃ te dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ dh+wa dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ tik+ṣa ṇoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ tshā tra shwe toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐/ oṃ mai tri hūm̐/ oṃ a mo gha dṛṣ+ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ durga ta sarba nā ya ka hūm̐/ oṃ durga la ni s+sa ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ gan+dha hasti hūm̐/ oṃ shu raṃ ga mo hūm̐/ oṃ ga ga na ko ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na ke tu hūm̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ tsan+d+ra pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ su pā la hūm̐/ oṃ dzā li ni pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ ga ya garbaha hūm̐/ oṃ ak+ṣa ya ma ti hūm̐/ oṃ pra ti bhān ku ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya hoḥ zhes pa brgya stong sogs ci rigs bzlas so// de nas gtso 'khor thams cad thun mong du rtsa ba'i rig pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas/ khor yug gi mgron thabs so so'i thugs kar rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa re re gsal bar gyur par dmigs te/

oṃ na mo bha wa te sogs rtsa rig ci 'grub bzla bar bya'o// de dag ni dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim rnams so/// / ༈ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thog mar rtsa ba'i lha la 'bul ba'i gtor ma dkar zhing zlum pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad kyis spras par rgyan dang ldan pa dkyil 'khor gyi nub byang mtshams su bzhag pa la chu bran te/ bsangs gzi sbyangs te sngon 'gro'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par dmigs te/ pad+ma kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po sbu gu can gyi rnam pas gtor ma drangs nas gsol bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du stong nyid dang ro gcig par mos la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni ye i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa sā dha ka s+ya shān+tiṃ rak+ṣaṃ tsa ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsum dang*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇī ṣa i maṃ ba liṃ sogs rtsa ba'i lha so bdun po'i mtshan sngags mthar/ i maṃ sogs btags pa gsum gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor rnam pa brgyad// sgeg sogs bzhi dang byang sems bcu drug bcas// mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang sgo skyong tshogs// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams tshogs la bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// sogs kyis bstod la/

dril bu gsil zhing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir spro na rang gi chos skyong so sor gtor ma rang rang gi sngags kyis gtor ma phul nas phrin las gang sgrub kyi sdong grogs bcol/ de nas mgron thabs kyi phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma phyi la 'bul ba ni/ dkar gtor gcig chus sbyangs la sngon 'gro'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs| oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par dmigs te/ pad+ma kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad skad cig gis mdun du bkug /oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod nas/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pa mdun gyis gtor ma phul nas/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ phyogs skyong lha klu gza' skar sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba'i mthu mnga' zhing*// dkyil 'khor khor yug la gnas pa'i// mgron thabs lnga bcu rtsa drug tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms las// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol la dril bu gsil zhing gtor ma gtsang sar phul nas/

yig ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod la/ hūm̐ muḥ gtor mgron rnams khor yug gi lha so so dang gnyis su med par gyur ces brjod| nye reg slob dpon shan+ti pa'i dgongs bzhed ni/ tsog pur 'dug la cang mi smra bar lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du chu gtsang ma blugs pa lag pa'i gru mo gnyis pus mo'i nang du tshud par byas la/ lag pa'i gung mo gnyis dang srin lag gis mchu la reg cing kha'i phyogs su lan gsum byab pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas mig gnyis dang*/ rna ba'i bu ga gnyis dang*/ ya mchu dang*/ g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma rnams su reg /g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma la'ang lag pa g.yas pa rang gis reg /gos kyi phyi nas gtor ba bya/ mgo bor yang reg /chu de nyid kyis kha bshal phyi rol phyogs der pho/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis kha phyis la slob dpon gyi rting mnan te phyir 'brang gi bgegs rnams suṃ bha nis bskrad de g.yon brkyang gis rdo rje khu tshur gyis mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel mdzub mo rtse sprad pa'i rgyas/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥphaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ā ā ā phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha na mā ra ya duṣ+ṭāṃ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a ā oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags tshar bzhis dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi'i sgo dbye bar mos nas/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig /ces gsol ba gdab bo| |de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ oṃ pra we sha bha ga wān ma hā su kha mok+ṣa pu raṃ sarba sid+dhi su kha nirbabra ti pa ra ma su khot+ta ma sidh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra sidh+ya swā hā/ thar pa'i grong du bcom ldan bde chen 'jug |dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba'i/ /mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bo hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod// zhes rang nyid spro ba bskyed pas zhugs nas g.yas bskor du gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis sgo phye ste slar me tog gi phreng ba thogs nas/

oṃ pa ra ma su khā sha ya su la li ta bi lā sa na mi te t+na mā mi bha ga wān+taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hi hīḥ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan| |sgeg pa'i gzugs kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi hi hīḥ /mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor du dor/ slar me tog de nyid bslangs la phreng ba'i dbang gis bsam pas/ oṃ sa ma ya pra we sha yā mi/ zhes brjod la rang gi mgor bcings/ de nas slob ma'am/ tshe 'das gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ thog mar slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga bshad nas de nyid tshe 'das la'ang rigs 'gre bar bya ste/ de yang thog mar slob ma gdong g.yogs dang bcas te gzhug pa ni/ lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma nas bshad pa ltar slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lhag gnas byas pa nyer lnga man chad zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus nas dbyung*/ gu gul gyis bdug la yol ba'i phyir bzhag pa la/ las sngags bzlas pa'i gos dmar po/ bar 'dir khrus byed/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅkā ra was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyan gos kyi mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho 'phro ba'i dam tshig /zhes smad g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor can/ zhes pas gtsug tor sngon po rnams bskon/ las sngags/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ bzlas pa'i dar dmar ser gang rung khyer te/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ mig 'ching ba'i mchog byed pa/ zhes mig bcings/ a khaṃ bā'i ra hūm̐/ nam mkha'i dpa' po/ rdo rje srung ba zhes me tog gi phreng ba gtad pa bzung zhing yon phul nas/

pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi// chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod// dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// byang chub chen po tshul bstan pa| |mgon po chen po bdag phyag 'tshal// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma las thams cad pa'i oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis chus bsangs la/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes dri'i thig les mas yar 'bru gsum bkod nas/ rang ngam slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje nag po brtsegs pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ spyi
