bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po de dag gi 'od zer gyis lus 'od gsal bar byas pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsgom/ hūm̐ */ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bzhag nas/ slob dpon gyis/ kye/ dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dris par slob mas/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes gsol/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed par bgyid do// zhes brjod cing rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzung nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ| shin tu dga' ba'i dam tshig khyod ngo mtshar grub pa'i rdo rje ji ltar bde ba/ zhes pas sems bskyed brtan par byas nas de nas thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir slob mas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyid de// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog

/ces gsum brjod/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa rigs lnga dang 'brel ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi sdom pa 'dzin 'dod kyis de nyid stsol bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la bstsal nas ni// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag ni// de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyid// zhes gsum gyis khyad par du gsol ba btab la/ sdom pa dang sems bskyed dngos ni/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma rgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod/

yang na gzhung 'di'i rigs lnga'i sdom gzung ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum// dge ba dang ni chos sdud dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims ni// bdag gis so sor brtan por gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum mchog bla na med// sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor byung*// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje chen po rigs bsdus la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// de nyid kyis ni rab tu gzung*// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi| |rin chen chen po'i rigs mchog gi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin// pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag pa// byang chub chen po 'byung ba la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las chen rigs ni bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bzhin// kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa yang dag bskyed bgyi zhing*// sdom pa ma lus bzung bgyis nas// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// gsum brjod pas sdom pa 'dzin du bcug go// slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/

khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes gdams so// de nas nang du gzhug pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ zhes yol ba'i nang du khrid par dmigs nas/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ nam mkha'i dpa' bo/ zhes yol ba bsal nas/ slob mas/ oṃ ma hā ra ti su dṛ ḍho su to ṣ+ya su kho badz+ra satwa āt+ma sid+dh+ya mi| dga' ba chen po shin tu brtan pa rab tu dgyes pa legs par bde ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' da lta bdag la grub par mdzod/ ces brjod cing g.yas skor gsum byas te/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor slob mas thal mo sbyar bas mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i phyir bdag nyid du dbul bar bgyi'o// sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig /zhes dang*/ slar yang shar nas rnam snang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pū dzopa s+thānā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i phyir bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o// sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig /zhes dang*/ lhor rin 'byung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā tā ya mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing dbang bskur ba'i phyir bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o// sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rin chen gyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes dang*/ nub tu 'od dpag med la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing rab tu bskor ba'i phyir bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o// sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra warta yā mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje chos bdag la rab tu bskor du gsol/ zhes dang*/ byang du don grub la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ni āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o// sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje las kyi bdag la mdzod/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon la dmigs te/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇopas+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ bla ma'i zhabs la nye bar gnas pa'i phyir bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes phyag byed du gzhug go| |oṃ sarba satwa pa ri ta ra ṇar+thaṃ āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sems can thams cad yongs su bsgral ba'i phyir bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi'o// de nas phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob ma'i lag g.yas nas slob dpon gyi g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas bzung ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar yang mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzung nas/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems// zhes dang*/

snying gar rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ/ de ring rnam par snang mdzad rang*// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ */de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes bka' bsgo/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi dung chos kyi mna' chu mtheb srin gyis bzung ba slob ma'i khar blugs shing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ bdud rtsi lnga'i chu/ zhes mna'i btung ba sbyin/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ slob dpon gyis lag gi rdo rje dang bcas pas slob ma'i lag nas bzung ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ gal te 'gal na khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar shi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do/ dam bzhag 'di rnams byed pa'i gnas ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bya bar bshad do// de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi brlab tu gsol| |shākya seng ge rnam snang chen po bdag la dbab par gyur cig /gsum gsol/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes su āḥlas byung ba'i gsung rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs pa/ de'i snying gar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan par zla ba la ha dkar po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la a dmar po/

rkang pa dag gi 'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum yi ge ras mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos slob ma 'degs bzhin pa las/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis thugs dang sku dang gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyi rang bzhin hūm̐ haḥ.aḥyi yi ge rnams la bstim zhing rkang pa'i bu ga nas dzhaiḥgi 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa dang*/ hūm̐ la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar gyur par dmigs te/ slob dpon gyis sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying khar bzhag la/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya gang*// rdo rje ye shes bla na med// de ring khyod la 'bebs par mdzad// ces brjod cing slar yang slob dpon gyis lag g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas/ gu gul sbyar ba'i spos phor 'degs pas/ ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ haḥ.aḥdzhaiḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnam pa brgyar gdon zhing bsam gtan la gzhol bas dbab par bya'o// de nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la brtan par byas nas| slob ma dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod kyi mig la ji ltar snang*// zhes dris par/ slob mas/ kha dog so sor mthong na de ltar smra zhing*/ yang na/ kha dog sna tshogs nyid du mthong*// zhes gsol/ bla mas/ phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas kyis slob ma'i mthe bong gnyis nas bzung la las thams cad pa'i oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ brjod cing dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba'am der mos la/ slob dpon gyis bden pa'i byin rlabs 'di rdor dril 'dzin pas brjod de/

yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma'am tshe 'das gzhug pa 'di'i// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji ltar de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra ba// de 'drar dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du gzhug pa ni/ sngar gtad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba trām̐ gis sngags pa ma rnying ba zhig thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ba gus pas sngon du 'gro bas/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi dbu la 'bul ba'i 'dun pas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa to me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ gnas pa rdo rje brtan pa bdag la rtogs pa bdag la snying po bdag la| lhag par gnas la thams cad dngos grub bdag la stsol/ a khaṃ bā'i ra hūm̐/ nam mkha'i dpa' po/ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ so sor bzhes me tog thal mo mgon po kye/ zhes brjod la gtor ro// gzhung 'dir dri med 'od kyi lung bzhin/ rdul tshon la me tog dor bas nyams na sdig tu 'gyur phyir rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma la 'dor ba dang*/ sems dge ba la nyes pa med// ces pa'i lung gis de la rdul tshon du 'dor yang nyes med du gsungs so// me tog de re kha lnga'i nang du lhung ba na lha gang yin de'i rigs brtag cing de'i rnal 'byor dang dngos grub kyang mtshon zhing*/ gtso bo'i mdzod spu'am gtsug tor la phog na mchog gi dngos grub/ spyan dang zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub/ sku'i stod smad bar gsum la mchog dman bar ma'i dngos grub/ sku las ha cang ring na dus 'gyang zhing nye na myur ba'i dngos grub/ lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs/ mnyam na gnyis ka'am gang la dad pa de dang*/

rtsig pa'i phyir lhung na lan gsum bskyar zhing*/ de las kyang phyir lhung na dngos grub phra mo tsam/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med cing de la dkyil 'khor yang mi ston par sngags bzlas pa sogs kyi skal ldan du bsgrubs nas skabs gzhan du gzhug /phyi'i rdo rje phreng ba'i nang du lhung na tshegs chen pos 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes ngo sprad/ me tog de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs pa slob ma'i mgor bcings la// oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa twaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba laṃ/ so sor zung zhig khyod kyis 'di sems dpa' stobs po che/ zhes brjod cing bcing ba ni/ dbang dang po me tog gi phreng ba'i dbang zhes bya'o// de nas slob ma'i snying gar bdag po'i sa bon hūm̐ dpral bar ram̐ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ re re gsal bar gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ/ de ring rnam par snang mdzad rang*// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni dbye bar mdzod// oṃ dzñā natsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ ye shes kyi mig /zhes gdong g.yogs bsal nas/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ kye rdo rje ltos shig /zhes pas blta bar bskul nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar gyur par mos la/ slob dpon gyis/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// phyag rgya sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs| |dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs// dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro// zhes spro ba bskyed/ slob mas ched du brjod pa ni/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes dam tshig brjod du gzhug go// de ltar zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba ni/

thog mar rigs dbang lnga las bum dbang 'khor bcas zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob mas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khrus dkyil rdul tshon nas 'bras btags pa'i khu bas re kha lnga ldan gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la rta babs sogs med pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi phyi'i re kha gru bzhi nang ma'i shar sogs su 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ral gri dang*/ mtshams rnams su yum bzhi'i sa bon bris pa'i khrus dkyil lam/ bsdu na tshom bu dgu pa de gnyis gang rung gi steng du seng ge'i khri'i steng du zla ba'i stan dang bcas pa bzhag go// de lta bu'i khrus dkyil gyi steng du slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i gzugs su bsgoms pa dkyil 'khor la mngon par phyogs te bzhag pa la sbyang ba'i rim pa bya ba ni/ sbyang chas rnams slob dpon gyi mdun du bstar te thog mar/ khrus kyi dkyil 'khor re kha lnga dang ldan pa gru bzhi pa rta babs rnam par spangs pa'i sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du phyogs bzhir 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mtshams su yum bzhi'i sa bon dang ldan pa'i phyi rol re kha gru bzhi can gyi dbus su seng khri zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du slob ma'am/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen por gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ dang*/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i yungs kar khu tshur gnyis kyis bzung la re re nas g.yon dang g.yas su lan gnyis gnyis bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya sdig pa thams cad bsreg pa'i rdo rje yis/ badz+ra satwa s+ya/ rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ slob ma'i gsang mtshan mtshon byed dang*/

sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā| sdig pa thams cad sregs shig /zhes brjod cing mer dor/ de bzhin du khu tshur gnyis kyi chu dang*/ kham phor dkar po dang*/ rtswa dūr+wa'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i ba lci'i changs bu dang*/ zan gyi changs bu ting lo sbrags pa dang*/ seng ras tshal pa rnams kyang bzhi bzhis sngar bzhin byabs shing kham phor ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams mer dor ro/ de nas slob ma la gtso bo'i sngags/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni swā hā/ zhes snying gar dris byugs shing*/ mgor/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba bcings la/ mdun du mchod yon sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgya dang bcas pas phul nas/ mar me/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hās yongs su bskor te/ las sngags/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ dang*/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i mar dang spos dkar gyis bdug par bya'o// de nas chu dbang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya seng ge rnam snang chen por skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha dang lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ na bza' la sogs pa slob ma'i steng phyogs su 'dzin/ glu dang gar mdzad cing rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra sgrog /me tog dang gur gu+um la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/

/dam chos ldan pa thos dang bkra shis kyis phyug cing*// dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ */des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis kyi glu nye bar len bzhin pas/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril mnyam par slob ma'i spyi bor bzung nas/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag par rdo rje rab zhugs te| |mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ rdo rje sems dpas khyod la dbang bskur ba'i phyir rdo rje ming gi mngon par dbang bskur ba'o/ kye dpal/ zhes bos nas/ me tog bzung ba'i lha'i rigs kyi ming ngam/ yang na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam snang gi mtshan ni/ skyes pa la rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ oṃ mdzad rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje/ sgyu ma rdo rje/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/ gzugs rdo rje/ sku rdo rje/ zhes pa gang rung dang*/ bud med la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje sgeg mo/ rdo rje spyan ma/ gti mug dga' ma rnams gang 'thad re re'o// che ge mo khyod bdag de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje la'o/ */ zhes gsang mtshan btags nas rdor dril spyi bor mnyam par bzung zhing dbang bskur dang*/ oṃ badz+ro da kas chu dbang bskur/ de'i tshe des bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor slob ma la thim/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas slob ma'i gzugs kyi phung po smin par byas| gti mug gi dri ma bkrus/ me long ye shes kyi sa bon rgyud la bskrun/ rnam par snang mdzad dang skal pa mnyam par gyur/ ces don bshad/ de ltar phreng ba dang chu la sogs pa dbang drug po 'di rnams ma rig pa'i gnyen po nus pa nyid du sgrub par byed pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// dbang 'di rnams bskur bas slob ma bya ba dang*/

spyod pa'i rgyud dag nyan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ sngags bsgrub pa rnams la dbang bar 'gyur ro// rnam 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyang ngo*/ zhes slob dpon du rlom pa ni/ lung dang mi ldan te lhan cig skyes pa'i dbang dang sdom pa dang bral ba la de'i rang bzhin brjod par bcom ldan 'das kyis gang du'ang bka' ma bstsal zhing rigs pa'ang ma yin no// zhes brda sprad/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i don du/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing thal mo sbyar te/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*| |thugs rje'i gter kye bdag la stsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma'am rang nyid skad cig gis me tog phog pa'i lha de'am/ gtso bo'am/ yang na pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs par gyur/ dpon slob gnyis kas mos la/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril thogs te/ de nyid kyis ni rdo rje bzung*// chos kyi dril bu dkrol nas ni// dam tshig gi ni phyag rgya che// byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla// oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ rdo rje chen po/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ rdo rje dril bu/ zhes brjod cing slob mas g.yas rdo rje snying ga dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bzung nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid dang 'gal srid byas// rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yis// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// zhes slob mas brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po bzung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes brjod/

de nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lha dang lha mo rnams kyis slob ma'i steng phyogs kyi nam mkhar gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ na bza' la sogs pa 'dzin/ glu dang gar mdzad cing rol mo sna tshogs sgrog /me tog gi char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dbang gi lhas phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can gyi byang chub sems kyi bcud bzang pos gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur bzhin pas/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa lag tu thogs pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzung zhing bum chu 'thung du gzhug gam/ rnam rgyal gyi chu lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas bum pa'i kha rgyan bzung ba'i lo ma'i rtse mos blangs te slob ma'i spyi bor blugs bzhin pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig gi ched du gzhi tshugs/ zhes dbang bskur chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo slob ma la bstim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ legs par rab tu gnas pa'i rdo rje la gzhi tshugs/ zhes dang*/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ rig dbang gi bum pa'i dbang yang slob dpon a bha yas rdo rje slob dpon gyi lag g.yas bum pa'i kha rgyan rdo rje dang bcas pas bzung ba'i lo ma'i rtse mos chu blangs te slob ma'i spyi bor blug

|zhes gsungs pas/ bum pa mgor 'jog pa dang bum chu khar btung ba'i bshad pa med kyang*/ deng sang bod kyi bla ma dag gi phyag len la bum pa mgor 'jog cing chu blud pa dang bkru ba sogs mdzad pa de dag 'dir ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med pa phreng ba'i dkyil chog gis grub cing*/ byas kyang lhag pa'i nyes pa med do// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ gang las dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam par snang ba 'di nyid rang gi sems nyid rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba las// dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags// zhes gsungs shing*/ sems de nyid la phung khams skye mched rnams su snang ba ni brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ phung po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi gshegs ma'i gdan/ nang gi skye mched sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched sems ma'i gdan/ yan lag dang tshigs rtsa rnams khro bo khro mo'i gdan te gdan gsum tshang ba'o// mdor na gtso bo gcig gi zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rol par shar ba yin pas/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud ltar rten brten pa don gzhan dang lha rnams rgyud tha dad pa dang phyi nang mchog dman sogs gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma thams cad spangs te chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid du bzhag par bya'o// zhes go ba bshad/ de nas/ khyod kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin pas dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing sgrub pa dang*| 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang bya ba'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes dang*/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid la sogs pa shes pa dang*/

dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa de kho na bzhin du bsgrub par bya ba la skal pa ste nus pa dang ldan pa yin la/ rdo rje 'chang gi bcas pa las 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'i ngo bo ni/ 'di dam tshig dang*/ bya rgyu mi byed pa dang*/ mi bya rgyu byed pa/ 'gog pa'i ngo bo ni sdom pa yin pas de nyid nges pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du

sgrub par byos shig /ces gdams so/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi mtha' rten ni/ sngags gtad pa la slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i sngags ni/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni swā hā/ brgya 'am gsum sogs bzlas la/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lha la gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad ltar byung ba zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas su zhugs te snying gar 'khor bar gyur par bsam la/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags dang*/ rtsa rig ni/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni swā hā/ tshar gsum/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ tshar gsum/ de bzhin du/ oṃ rat+noṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+moṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐| oṃ bi shwoṣ+ṇīṣa hūm̐/ oṃ te dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ dh+wa dzoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ tik+ṣa ṇoṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ tshā tra shwe toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐/ oṃ mai tri hūm̐/ oṃ a mo gha dṛṣ+ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ durga ta sarba nā ya ka ham̐'u/ oṃ durga la ni s+sa ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ gan+dha hasti hūm̐/ oṃ shu raṃ ga mo hūm̐/ oṃ ga ga na ko ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na ke tu hūm̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ tsan+d+ra pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ su pā la hūm̐/ oṃ dzā li ni pra bha hūm̐/ oṃ ga ya garbaha hūm̐/ oṃ ak+ṣa ya ma ti hūm̐/ oṃ pra ti bhān ku ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya hoḥ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/

ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ gsum re slob mas brjod de/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ sngags dang me tog 'thor/ de nas mig sman gyi cho ga ni/ gser dngul gyi snod du bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi la sbyar ba'i mig sman gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rje'i rtse mos blangs la/ slob ma'i mig dag la yi ge praṃ re re gsal bar gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas mos la/ slob dpon gyis sman bku zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis| |ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin// rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi// mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal// zhes brjod la dbye ba'i tshul bya/ de nas me long gi cho ga ni/ slob dpon gyis me long thogs la| yi ge aḥs sngags pa slob ma'i gdong la bstan nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*| |rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rang bzhin med cing gnas med par| |chos rnams de ltar shes nas khyod// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes brjod/ de nas mda' 'phang ba'i cho ga ni/ slob dpon gyis/ yi ge hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu hoḥ sarba ta thā ga tāṃ a nu rā ga ya swa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rjes su chags par byos shig /ces brjod cing slob ma la gtad la/ des kyang*/ sarba ta thā ga tāṃ a nu rā ga yā mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rjes su chags par bgyi'o// zhes brjod cing bgegs la 'gengs pa'i bsam pas/

phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og ste drug tu mda' re re 'phang ba'am de'i stangs bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis/ de ltar dbang bskur bas ri mo'am lus dkyil du zhugs shing mthong*/ rdo rje slob dpon nam/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang thob/ de'i sgra don byang sems phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bcu pa rnams la phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba ltar/ bla ma lha dang bcas pas sems can dpag tu med pa la gzhal du med par chos ston pa la sogs pa'i slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du khams gsum pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur bas slob dpon gyi dbang dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi dbang dang 'dra zhing*/ de kho na nyid thob pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon nyid kyang bskrun pas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang zhes bya bar go zhing rigs pas rtogs par bya ba dag go// de nas dbang spyi'i mtha' rten rnams las/ dang po rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sems skyil gyis bzhugs par gyur par dmigs te/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thogs nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// zhes brjod la/ slob ma'i g.yas su gtad/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi grub pa'i rdo rje dam tshig brtan pa 'dis khyod kyis rdo rje sems dpa' gzung bar bgyi/ hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ 'di rnams ni ye shes lnga chos nyid dang drug go// zhes brjod cing bzung bar bya'o// de nas lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam gyis rkang pa gshibs te langs la/

snam sbyar ram chos gos kyi grwa seng ge bag phab pa'i rna ba ltar byas pa'i khu tshur g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas snying gar bzung*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya slob mar bstan la/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas// srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs| |bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan bgyi// kye che ge mo rdo rje/ ta thā ga ta sid+dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du bsgrub pa'i dam tshig dang ldan pa khyod/ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i sa 'og /sa steng gi 'jig rten/ mtho ris te srid rtse'i mthar thug pa'o// gang yang ngas 'di ltar lung bstan pa de la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams can kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad pa chos nyid yin no// zhes lung bstan/ lung bstan ni khams gsum dang dbyer med pa'i chos nyid rtogs par nus pa khyod yin no// zhes gzengs bstod pa'i don du lung bstan pa'o// zhes 'jigs med dgongs rgyan nas gsungs/ ༈ /rjes gnang la thog mar spyi'i rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyis 'khor lo thogs te/ bh+rūṃ las skyes pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ slob ma'i mdun nam stan du byin la/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ rdo rje rgyu/ zhes brjod/ dung thogs te/ aḥlas skyes pa'i dung oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣi taṃ/ rdo rje smra ba/ zhes lag g.yas su gtad/ po ti thogs la/ aḥlas skyes pa'i po ti aḥ zhes lag gnyis su sbyin/ dril bu thogs nas/ aḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu aḥ zhes lag g.yon du sbyin la dkrol du gzhug cing*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas// thams cad mchog ni mnyam nyid gsal// deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// tsam gyis chos dung bla med pa// kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// zhes slob dpon gyis brjod do// de nas rigs so so bye brag pa'i rjes gnang ni/

slob ma rnam snang sogs rigs lnga rim gyis bsgom du gzhug cing 'khor lo gtad la/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad la// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas// skye med dogs dang bral ba yis/ /de ltar sems can don gyis shig /rdo rje ni/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad la/ /sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul ba yi| |rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas// skye med dogs dang bral ba yis// de ltar sems can don gyis shig |rin chen ni/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad la// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul ba yi// rin chen 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas// skye med dogs dang bral ba yis// de ltar sems can don gyis shig /pad+ma ni/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad la// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul ba yi// pad+ma'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas// skye med dogs dang bral ba yis// de ltar sems can don gyis shig /ral gri ni/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad la// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul ba yi// ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas// skye med dogs dang bral ba yis// de ltar sems can don gyis shig /ces brjod cing phyag mtshan de rnams gtad la/ de dag ni rigs lnga las brtsams pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bshad byed pa'i rjes gnang byin pa'o// de nas slob mas phyag byas te/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' bsgo ba// de bzhin du ni bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum gsol lo// de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor gdugs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgor thal mo sbyar te gnas pa la| |slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ba yi// slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ zhes slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul ba'i don no// zhes brjod/ de nas gdugs logs shig tu bzhag la/ slob ma'i snying la 'bab pa brjod par bya ste/ 'di dbugs dbyung ba dngos yin/ da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*| |lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur// sems can kun la brtse don du/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor| |mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di las ni| |phyin chad khyod la 'chi ba med// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa mtha' 'das grub chen du// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro| |khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che'i// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// gzhan yang gang dag cho ga ji lta ba bzhin dbang bskur ba la dge ba'i phyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sdug pa'i bu dang 'dra bar thugs dang bas yang dag par dgongs par mdzad pa 'di ni chos nyid yin no// zhes brjod/ de ltar dbang thob cing dbugs phyin te dga' ba'i slob mas/ de ltar bgyi'o// deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas// bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su deng bdag gyur// ces gsol nas rta dang rin po che dang gos dang 'bru sogs dang*/

gces pa'i bu dang chung ma la sogs pa yon du phul nas slob mas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes gsol nas/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal rgyas par dbul lo// de nas slar slob ma'am/ tshe 'das 'jug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub zhu zhing bden pa'i byin rlabs bya ba ni/ rdor dril 'dzin cing dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol zhing*/ oṃ/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan med phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// mi bskyod rdo rje deng bdag sgrub// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrub mdzod// nyes pa med pa rtag pa khyod// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che// de kho nyid la bdag sgrub mdzod// shin tu rnam dag chos kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpar bdag sgrub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang chen mchog gi phyag rgya yis// rdo rje chen po gsor ba las// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag sgrub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin/ dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa de yis mgon po khyod// 'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzod| |chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*// de nyid de bzhin nyid nges 'byung*| |bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal ba slob ma'am tshe 'das bdag cag rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog

/ces lan gsum rjod/ de dag ni slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i rim pa dag go// // ༈ /de nas tshe 'das rjes 'dzin lho sgo'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su stegs bu khru gang gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus su gnas yig legs par btags pa'i ro 'am/ rus bu 'am/ byang bu sogs bzhag par las thams cad pa'i chu dang las sngags kyis bsangs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis sbyangs/ rten snang ba mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las tshe 'das kyi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe las 'das pa tha mal pa'i cha byad phung khams skye mched thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa a thung gi gzugs can bkug nas rten gyi spyi gtsug nas brgyud snying gar thim pas gson po'i snang ba kho na ltar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang bcings kyi mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa cung zad bkug mthe'u chung gnyis khab ltar brkyangs pa 'gug pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa rigs lngar bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rigs sngags rnams kyi lha'i khyad par rnams dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das dpal ngan song sbyong ba shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad gtsug tor dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa srid pa bar do khams gsum rigs drug skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gang du gnas kyang skad cig nyid la rten 'dir mchis par gyur cig

/ces gsum/ lnga/ bdun| dgu/ nyer gcig sogs brjod/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ ā na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib rnams kyang bkug par bsam/ khu tshur kha steng du phyogs pa'i mthe'u chung lcags sgrog ltar sbrel/ mdzub mo bkug cing gyen du 'phang ba ltung ba slong ba'i rgyas/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ā kar+ṣa ṇi bi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ngan 'gro thams cad bkug pa dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i ngan 'gro rnams dang*/ dbyer med du byas pa de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di las bskyab tu gsol/ bdag cag sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang rdo rje slob dpon la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs su 'gro bzhin par dmigs la rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis bsgrengs pa/ mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung bsrangs te mnye zhing dril ba sdig pa 'joms pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba a pā ya/ bhan+dha ni pra mok+ṣa ṇa/ sarba a pā ya ga te bh+yaḥ sarba trā sa naṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ ces sdig pa thams cad bcom par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i sgra dang bcas pa lan gsum snying gar bya ba sdig pa dral ba'i rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ a pā ya bi sho dha ni hūm̐ swā hā/ badz+ra bhan+dha traṭa/ ces brjod pas/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ de nas mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar ba bkram pa 'khor lo'i rgya tshe 'das kyi spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ mthe bong gshibs te sor bcu so sor brkyangs pa pad+ma'i rgya mgrin par/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gung mo mthe'u chung rnams so sor gshibs te brkyangs/ mdzub mo dang ming med sems skyil ltar byas pa rdo rje'i rgya snying gar/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes pa rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya'o// slar yang rdo rje'i rgya de nyid// tshe 'das kyi ni gnas rnams te// snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs su// dpral ba mdzod spu rnam pa gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas// zhes pa'i gnas nyer gnyis su gtug cing*/

oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs so// de nas bgegs sbyang ba ni/ gtor chung zlum po gsum chus sbyangs/ a kā ro gsum gyis brlabs te/ oṃ bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs sngags tshar gsum dang bcas te/ rten la g.yas su bskor zhing gsog snod du dor ba zhi bas sbyang ba dang*/ ting lo mar me changs bu dang sbrags pa gsum gyis g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ ni hūm̐/ sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags gsum gyis bskor ba gsog snod du dor ba zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o// de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgya dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo gshegs su 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes bzhugs su gsol| oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod nas/ hūm̐ */ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*| |thabs la mkhas pa'i 'jig byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs gdug can rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog

/khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod| |hūm̐ */ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas| sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la/ gson pa'i dus su tshe la bar du gcod cing tshe 'phos nas gang du gnas pa'i lus srog dang*/ mtho ris dang*/ thar pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad dang*/ tshe las 'das pa'i cha byad bzung nas de'i nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa rnams la bslu zhing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dang 'byung po la sogs pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par bgyis la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spongs la phan bde byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang gi gnas su song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas sreg cing rnam par 'joms pa gdon mi za'o// zhes brjod cing gtor chung dang ting lo rgya lam du dor/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brab/ suṃ bha ni sogs drag sngags brjod pa ni drag pos sbyang ba'o// de nas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rang gi mdun du dud pa dang bral ba'i me dang ting bkod la/ tshe 'das kyi rkang mthil gnyis su rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu/ lte bar me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ dmar po/ rkang zhabs kyi rlung gis bskyod pas hūm̐ gi 'od zer me lce'i rnam pa snying ga'i bar du 'bar bas snying ga'i kaṃ yig sdig pa'i rang bzhin sha za'i gzugs can mi sdug pa mdog sngo nag /bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba/ rlig pa 'phyangs shing skra brdzes pa/ de nyid me 'od kyis gdung ste sna bug nas thon pa til la thim par gyur pas til rnams kyang de lta bu'i gzugs su gyur/

me bsang gzi sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ mchu la pad+mas bskor ba'i stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po gsus pa 'phyang ba/ shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i mche ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mche ba phyar stabs su gdengs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khod pa/ dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa sna sgo nas thon te spros pa thab kyi nang du bzhugs pa'i zhal du phul bas gsol bar gyur/ ces dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha dā kha dā sa s+yaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes mtheb srin gyis til blangs pa rten la g.yon gyis g.yon dang*/ g.yas kyis g.yas su bskor nas mer dor gsum sogs bya/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā| de bzhin du chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod nas/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus// gnag cing mi sdug gzugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mche ba rab thogs pa// za byed khyod la 'dud par bgyi| |zhes bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad gsos la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de dag sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba'o// de nas bye ma'am yungs kar la/ rtsa rig dang kaṃ ka ni mang du bzlas pas rten la brab cing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇā ni bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bruṃ bi nā sha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la da ka da ka ha na ha na ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bri ta bri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na rak+ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing rten la brab/ de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pas dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba me long du 'char ba byas pa la/ skal bzang dam pa 'chi med dgyes// mchog tu mdzes pa'i cha byad can// rdo rje slob dpon dpal mchog la// bdag gi khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bkrus/ dar ram ras dkar la dri bzang gi rigs lnga'i sa bon nam thig le bris pas phyi ba'i tshul gyis/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes phyis/ yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa// ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi// mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ ma rig 'joms pa'i nyi ma ste// srid pa'i nad ni sel ba'i sman// dam chos rin chen 'di dag la// bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/
