sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /ces brjod/ de rnams ni phyir zlog gis sbyang ba'o// gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi skabs/ dbang rgyas pa slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar ram/ sngags tsam la brten pa'ang rung bar gsung pas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ smad g.yogs dang stod g.yogs gtsug tor sogs sbyin par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅkā ra was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ mig dar me tog gtad la/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi// chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod| |dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol| |sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// las chus bsangs la/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ kye/ dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin// zhes dris par slob mas/ bde chen dang ni skal bzang la'o// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u t+pā da yā mi/ rdo rje me tog snying gar bzung bar mos la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyid de// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog

/ces dang*/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la bstsal nas ni// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag ni// de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyi// sogs gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol| bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo*// rdo rje rig mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i| |pad+ma'i rig mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rig mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god| |lan gsum/

deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi rlob par 'gyur gyi khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma bzhugs pa rnams la smra ba mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ra ti su dṛ ḍho su to ṣ+ya su kho badz+ra satwa āt+ma sid+dh+ya mi/ phyogs bzhi dbus lngar phyag 'tshal bar dmigs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā tā ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra warta yā mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇa āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃ/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇopas+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba satwa pa ri ta ra ṇar+thaṃ āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ slob ma'i lag nas dam por bzung la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra ba mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ mgor rdo rje bzung la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di| |gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems// rdo rje snying khar bzung la/

oṃ/ de ring rnam par snang mdzad de// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// dung zhal gyi chu sbyin/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ rdo rje slob ma'i lag tu bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar shi ba'i dus byed nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shākya seng ge rnam snang chen po bdag la dbab par gyur cig /gsum/ khyod rang rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes su āḥlas byung ba'i gsung rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma g.yon des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs pa/ de'i snying khar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa zla ba la ha dkar po/ mgrin pa yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan pa zla ba la āḥdamar po/ rkang pa dag gi 'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum yi ge ras 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos slob ma 'degs bzhin pa la slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis thugs dang sku dang gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs spyan drangs la de rnams kyi rang bzhin hūm̐ haḥ.aḥyig rnams la bstim zhing rkang pa'i bu ga nas dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa dang*/

hūm̐ la sogs pa'i 'od zer gyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar dmigs te/ sems ma rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya gang*// rdo rje ye shes bla na med// de ring khyod la dbab par mdzod// ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ haḥ.āḥdzhaiḥ brtan par bya/ khyod kyi mig la ji ltar snang*/ dris/ kha dog sna tshogs nyid du mthong*/ brjod/ phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur// zhes lan gdab/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor bskor bar mos la/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis tshe 'das gzhug pa 'di'i| |lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji ltar de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'dra 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba| |de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /me tog dor la/ trāṃ/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa to me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ zhes dor/ slar me tog mgor bzhag te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa twaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba laṃ/ zhes dang mig dbye ba ni/ oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ dkyil 'khor mthong bas| da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// phyag rgya sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs// dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs| |dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro// tshe 'das kyis/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur ro// ho ho hoḥ dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ byang chub rdo rje'i gsol ba 'debs/

khrus dang sbyang ba sogs sngon du song bas mi dgos pa 'dra/ dmigs yul shākya seng ge gsal btab| slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis// bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// de ni de ring dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /sogs dang bum pa thogs la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbadz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ dbu rgyan thogs la/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyi rgyan pa'i// rin po che yi dbu brgyan dang*// dar dpyangs cod pan gyi ni dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+rūṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ dharma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ o+oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ rdo rje thogs/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yis// dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dril bu thogs/ oṃ/ dril bu shes rab dang ldan pa'i// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal nos shig

/oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe a aḥ rdo rje ming dbang*/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag par rdo rje rab zhugs ste// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ kye dpal oṃ mdzad rdo rje'o// thun mong du bum chu 'thor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des tshe 'das bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo slob mar thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du/ sa gzhi spos kyis sogs| gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter kye bdag la stsol// oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐| oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ bum dbang don du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ sngags dbang ni/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes rtsa rig tshar gsum brjod/ mig thur/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes dang me long bstan la/ āḥ mda' gzhu hoḥ sarba ta thā ga tāṃ a nu rā ga ya swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga tāṃ a nu rā ga yā mi/ tshe 'das rdor sems bsgom rdo rje thogs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hā'iḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ lung bstan| kye/ che ge mo rdo rje ta thā ga ta sid+dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhu rbahu waḥswaḥ/

bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ āḥlas dung*/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣi taṃ/ a las po ti/ aḥlas dril bu/ zhes brjod la gtad| rigs so so'i rjes gnang*/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul ba yi// rigs lnga'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong ba'i// skye med dogs dang bral ba yi// de ltar sems can don gyis shig /ces gtad/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag sogs/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// bar dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ las tshe 'das skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu kha nang du phyogs pa dkur brten pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*| |phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// zhes bstod/ 'dod yon rnams bsang gzi sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes thal mo khong stong smin mtshams su skyod pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rten gyi lha la yid bsngos pas// bzhes shig tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ badz+ra satwa rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshigs brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa/ */ mos blos rten gyi lha la yid bsngos pas// bzhes shig tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ badz+ra satwa shapad kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos rten gyi lha la yid bsngos pas// bzhes shig tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ badz+ra satwa gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rten gyi lha la yid bsngos pas// bzhes shig tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ badz+ra satwa ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rten gyi lha la yid bsngos pas// bzhes shig tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ badz+ra satwa spar+she kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ de nas 'dod yon rnams kyi phud bsdus pa mer bsregs pa'i gsur bya ste/ 'jig rten pha rol song ba'i tshe 'das la// de ring las dang 'brel ba'i nye du yis// nam zhag gtan gyi zas skom 'di bsngos pas// tshe 'das mi zad gter la spyod par shog /tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod par gyur cig /ces bsngo/ lam bstan cing sbyang ba ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun byang nas// 'phags pa'i lam der bgrod par shog

/oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na saṃ bha we/ rat+na ki rat+ne| rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe sho dha ya pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lam bstan cing*/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we ma hā su kha wa tī gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes lam sbyangs/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa dang lha ye shes pa dbyer med du spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thon te bde ba can gyi zhing khams su me tog pad+ma'i snying po las rdzus te skyes/ de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ de nas slar yang*/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams// de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs// tshigs bcad 'di rnams 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur las gsungs pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med// su zhig de yi mtshan brjod na// de ni de ru skye bar 'gyur// 'chi ba'i dus su ston pa ni// dge slong dge 'dun bcas te mthong*// de na bud med yod ma yin// mngal na gnas pa'ang yod ma yin// rin chen rnams kyi pad+mo las// rdzu 'phrul chen pos 'byung bar 'gyur// zas dang gos dang sman rnams dang*// chos gos mal cha lhung bzed rnams// sems kyis bsam ma thag tu ni// de dag mod la 'byung bar 'gyur// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bde ba can gyi bsngags pa brjod// 'di ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab// sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam mi khyab// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab// bsam mi khyab la dad byas na// rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab// rnam dag zhing du skye bar 'gyur// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ ces zhing de'i sngags pa brjod ci nga*/ der bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams la mchod/ de nas/ tshe las 'das pa des sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong zhing mchod nas gdams pa dang rjes su gnang ba thob/ lha rnams kyis brtags pas bdag gi mthur shes pas bdag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med// dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing med de// sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med// ces ched du brjod cing*/ tshe 'das kyis kyang rang nyid der skyes pa'i rgyur brtags/ bdag gis cho ga bgyis pa'i mthur shes nas skad cig gis mdun du 'ongs nas/ e ma shākya mgon po yi// sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che// gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi// sems can glog bzhin myur du sgrol// de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab// sngags kyi yon tan rnams kyang bsam mi khyab// byang chub bstan pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab// tshangs spyod tshul khrims dri med e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// sngags kyi mdzad pa ya mtshan che// gang phyir ngan song ltung ba yi// sems can lha gnas myur du skyes// zhes ched du brjod cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ slar yang bde ba can du gshegs par gyur/ oṃ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de lta bu'i tshul gyis dgung zhag zhe dgu'am/ bdun phrag sogs su sbyangs bas/ nub tha ma phung po'am rus bu sogs sreg chog byed na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg zur du yod pa ltar bya zhing*/ ming byang yin na sdig sgrib lhan cig tu raṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mes bsreg par gyur par bsam la/ dpal 'bar thogs te/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro// 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la// lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro// nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la// ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro// dbang po drug gi bud shing la// byang chub sems kyi me sbar ro// yul snang drug gi bud shing la// lha mo drug gi me sbar ro| |lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la// rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog

/ces rtsa rig brjod cing bsregs mthar/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*// rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta// zhes brjod cing bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o// lar tshe 'das kyi ro'am/ rus bu/ ming byang sogs la rnam shes dang sdig ltung chab cig tu bkug nas sbyang ba dang dbang bskur ba sogs byas te/ rnam shes gnas spar zhing sdig ltung sogs mer bsreg par bsam/ gson byang la de'i sdig sgrib dang rnam shes re zhig bkug pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ rnam shes de ma 'ongs par 'tshang rgya 'gyur du lam bstan nas re zhig snga ma ltar byas pa la/ de'i ming sogs kyi lhag ma sdig ltung lhan cig sreg par bsam dgos pa las/ deng sang rnam dbye med par gang thod thod kyis zang zing don gnyer gyi byang bu sreg pa rnams ni rang gzhan kun gyi thar pa'i rtsa ba sreg pa'i rgyu ma thal lam/ de dag ni gshin po rjes 'dzin lho sgo'i cho ga'i rim pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ de nas mchod pa bzang ba gsar du bsham mam/ rnying pa gsos par sngar ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnam pa lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa chos dbyings rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs la/

oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ sbyar bas byin brlabs la| rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos rdzas las grub cing*// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i zhabs bsil rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yon tan rgya mtsho rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul gyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa ma naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhabs bsil gyi gnas su/ bsang gtor/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo sogs rim pas sbyar te/ bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin las// rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// ngan song sbyong ba'i gnyen gcig pu// shākya seng ge khyod phyag 'tshal// rtsibs gyi nang ni thams cad du// bzhugs pa'i rdo rje gtsug tor sogs// rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams// rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi// grwa bzhi'i phyogs na legs bzhugs pa'i// sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu// gar sogs lha mo chen mo bzhi// bdag gi dad pas bstod par bgyi// lha rnams phyogs bzhir dgyes bzhugs pa'i// byams pa la sogs bcu drug tshogs// sa dang pha rol phyin mnga' ba'i// byang sems tshogs la bstod par bgyi// de yi grwa bzhir rab bzhugs pa'i// spos dang me tog mar me dri// mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi rnams la// gus pa'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi// phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams legs skyong ba// dad sogs ngo bo las byung ba'i/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i// mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa// mgron thabs lnga bcu rtsa drug tshogs// 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la/

thal mo sbyar te/ dge ba 'di yis khams gsum sems can kun// sdig ltung las kyis sbar ba'i me dpung gis// nyam thag yun ring mnar ba'i sdug bsngal rnams// skal bzang yid mkhar khyod kyi thugs rje yi// chu 'dzin dra ba'i phung po las thon pa'i// byams brtse bsil phreng char gyis gzhil bar mdzod// ces smon lam brjod la/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de kun bzod par gsol// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun gtso bos bzod mdzad rigs// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa gsum gyis chad lhag bskangs te/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ bdag mdun bum bskyed dang bcas pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs| dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ a yig ni chos thams cad kyi sgo ste gdod ma nas ma skyes ba nyid kyi phyir ro| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod cing chos thams cad skye ba med par mos la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// de nas/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog |sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog |sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog

/sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan gser mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra// 'jig rten gsum na 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku// bcom ldan sku yi bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan dung mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra// 'jig rten gsum na spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung*// bcom ldan gsung gi bkra shis gang lags pa/ bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan mthing mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra// 'jig rten gsum na phyag na rdo rje'i thugs// bcom ldan thugs kyi bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs sogs gzhan yang long dang bstun pa'i shis brjod ci rigs pa dang*/ bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs kyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyi phreng ba skor gsum zhes rgya bod kyi ljongs su nyi zla ltar grags pa de dag gi nang tshan las sbyong rgyud gtsug dgu lha so bdun pa'i dkyil chog gi skabs kyi rjes 'brangs te/ de yang sbyong rgyud yo ga'i theg par bzhugs pa la rung mthun du lho sgo'i cho ga sbyar zhing gzhan rnams phal cher phreng ba'i lugs ltar las bla med kho na'i tshul yang cung ma bgyis shing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud rang gi dkyus su'ang ma spyad pa/ phreng ba'i skabs su rgyud sde so sor dbye ba'i dgongs pa mi mdzad pa dang mdzad pa gnyis su yod pa'i phyi ma ltar bkod pa 'di ni rang gzhan mang po'i don du bgyis pa yin mod/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde so sor lho sgo'i cho ga gsungs ma gsung gi rnam par dbye ba med pa dag gi blun chen snying phod can dkyil 'khor gcig gi lag len yang 'khrul med du 'byed pa rngo mi thogs pa la las rnyed bkur dang grags pa 'ba' zhig lhur len pa'i smyon gtam gyi spyi brtol chen pos/

deng sang sa gzhi skyong ba'i khrims gnyis kyi 'ching ba zhig pas nyes pa tshar gcod kyi chad pa gyi na'ang med cing*/ rgyud rgyal so so'i rnam dbye phra zhib nas 'byed nus pa'i blo nor rnam dpyod kyi mig ldan med pa kho na'i rgyu mtshan nges don du byas te/ tshong 'dus dang grong khyer sogs rgyud las bkag pa'i gnas rnams su dam med kyi slob ma mang po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri chen por tshangs chen ltar 'gyings nas/ ras gcod gzu lum gyi smra ba ldab ldib mang pos tsham tshom med par rgyud kyi dbang bskur ro zhes zer zhing*/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa paṇa grub kyi 'grel bshad kyis ma bkral yang rang gi blor tshud pa'i dkyil chog gcig kho nar bdag gir bzung ste/ bde dgyes sogs la tshe 'das rjes 'dzin gyi lho sgo'i cho ga rnal 'byor spyod pa ltar rgyas 'gebs pa'i blun po rang nyid rang gi brtan sa ma zin par gzhan rgyud gshin po rjes su 'dzin 'dod kyi slob dpon tshe 'di'i zang zing kho na'i ched du rdo rje theg ba'i bstan pa bshigs pas tshe srog gi dbang po 'gag ma thag mnar med kyi gting rdo byed pa'i las 'di las rang gzhan phung krol bskyed pa'i rgyu gzhan dag ma mchis mod/ de lta na phyin chad sdig lta de lta bu thong la skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bcom bskyungs te bag yod par gyis shig /'dir smras pa/ rgyal kun skyed mdzad rdo rje btsun mo yi// yab gyur 'jigs med 'byung gnas he ru ka'i// phreng bar bkral ba'i rjes 'brang rung mthun du// lnga par gyur rnams rjes 'dzin cho gar bcas// rang 'dod khengs grags rnyed brtson 'byor tshogs kyi// ched du min mod 'on tang deng sang gi// tshe 'di'i zang zing rnyed bkur cung zad ched// chos brgyad gdon gyis brlams pas khrel med du// mkhas btsun nga zhes khengs grags nga ro yis// bdag bstod gzhan smod 'o dod skad gsang gis// mi bzad sdig chen phung po nyer bsags nas// mnar med dmyal ba'i g.yang sar rdeg 'chos pa'i// skal ngan deng sang bshes gnyen la la yi// dkyil chog myos gtam tshogs dang 'di mi mnyam// rdo rje btsun mos 'jigs med zhabs dngos la// legs par bstsal ba'i dkyil chog 'o mtsho che// de las byung ba'i 'jigs med dgongs pa'i rgyan// gaṅgā'i rgyun bzang gzhan gzhung rnyog ma yi// bsres lhad med cing rung mthun gshin po ni// rjes 'dzin dbu ba'i phreng bas nyer spras pa// dag gsal ngag gi lam nas nyer drangs te// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang po brgya phrag gis// 'dus shing gros nas mgrin gcig spel 'dra ba'i// ngan song sbyong chog zla ba'i snye ma 'di// rigs sngags 'chang ba kun gyi mgrin pa'i rgyan// deng sang rigs rus cho 'brang 'khor dang dbang*// 'byor ldan blo nor bral ba'i btsun btsun 'dra'i// pad sbubs lcags mdas khengs 'dra'i gang zag la// dge ba'i bshes zhes bstod cing bsngags pa brjod// blo gros stong gi rol rtsed zlos gar dang*// sngags gzhung mtha' yas rtogs pa'i 'phrul sgeg gis// legs bshad glu dbyangs sgrog kyang gyi nar rlom// kye ma rin thang che ba'i gser dngul yang*// legs par brtag na g.ya' yi rang bzhin las// mdzes byed gzhan ko 'byung ba'i go skabs med// gnas skabs rigs gzugs gyi na'i srin bu las// mthar thug dar zab rin thang med pa'i nor// dpag yas 'byung ltar deng sang de 'drar mthong*// 'di ni sngags gzhung rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i dkor// mdzes byed nam mkha'i thig dbang nyid yin phyir// 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i dri ma yod mi snyam/

/rgya la rnam g.yeng nyes rgya dri ma'i cha// cung zad mchis na gsang 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang*// rdo rje 'dzin rnams spyan sngar cis mi 'chags// de las byung ba'i dge ba dung lta bur// dkar ba'i chos kun nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i| |'gro kun ngan song 'ching ba las grol nas// shākya seng ge'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// de ltar ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga rgya mtsho dga' ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang rang nyid kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i ched du dang*/ dad pa dang skal par ldan pa'i slob ma rnams dang 'gro ba lnga par gyur pa'i nyam thag pa rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir kho na las/ rang 'dod dang tshe 'di'i khengs grags rnyed pa zang zing ched du ye nas min pa'i blos/ sngags gzhung rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son zhing rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs don so sor dbye ba la snyeng ba med pa'i dge slong*/ rig pa'i gnas bcu phrag smra zhing dbur stod 'bri gung du skyes pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal pa'i sdes/ dur+dha raṃ gaste zhes pa chu phag gi lo dka' thub can sbrang rtsi byed kyi dga' ma dang*/ lhan gcig rtse dgas rol ba'i dus la bab pa'i dkar cha'i dga' ba gnyis pa ston pa lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus chen/ dus kyi 'khor lo ltar na mya ngan las 'das pa'i yang dus te/ de ltar dus chen gsum 'dzoms pa'i dus khyad par can la/ mdo stod kyi sa'i thig le zla kun dga' tshal gyi chos kyi grwa yangs pa'i dbus su/ shrī bi kra ma la shī la zhes sam/ dpal rnam gnon tshul khrims kyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i yang steng du mgyogs par sbyar ba dag go// //swa sti sarba loka pra dze bh+yaḥ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ//
